name: hoobi-portfolio
description: Living resume and portfolio. Data-driven, pre-rendered to static JSON at build time and served by a React front end.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/schemas run build && pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/generator run build && pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/web run build
scripts.build:preview: pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/schemas run build && pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/generator run build && pnpm --filter @hoobi-portfolio/web run build:preview-test && pnpm run preview
scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:api
